title: Make parseCsv handle quoted fields, escaped quotes and CRLF

brief.goal: parseCsv in src/csv.ts splits on commas only; make it handle double-quoted fields containing commas, doubled quotes ("") as an escaped quote, CRLF line endings and a trailing newline.
constraints: Change only the files named in the goal; no new dependencies
Keep TypeScript strict; relative imports use explicit .ts extensions
Tests use node:test and node:assert/strict and run with node --experimental-strip-types --test
acceptanceCriteria: parseCsv('a,b\r\n"x, y","he said ""hi"""\n') returns [["a","b"],["x, y",'he said "hi"']]
a trailing newline does not produce an empty final row
the simple case in test/csv.test.ts keeps passing

expected_clean_output: A small state machine parses quotes, escaped quotes and CRLF; both tests pass.

seeded_defect.description: Quoted commas work but a doubled quote inside a field ends the field instead of producing a literal quote.
seeded_defect.how_to_detect: Grader: 'he said ""hi""' parses as 'he said ' plus stray fields.
